reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from July (590) to August (1180) and stayed elevated in September (1260) (E-05), and the majority of disputed bills (1,785 of 3,025, ~59%) are tied to ACTUAL meter reads rather than estimate substitution (E-02); with tariff rules unchanged (E-04) ruling out a tariff-application error, this points to a billing-calculation or meter-read-value error applied to actual-read bills as the dominant mechanism driving the dispute surge, not slow response (E-03 shows SLA is met) or estimate substitution alone.
